meta.name: security
meta.description: Create security architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with identity, encryption, firewall, and compliance stencil icons. Best for IAM flows, zero-trust models, encryption pipelines, and threat detection architectures.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 PlantUML 绘制安全架构图，包含身份、加密、防火墙等图标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要绘制 IAM、零信任或加密管线的安全架构图
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create security architecture diagrams for IAM, zero-trust, or encryption pipelines

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述，用 PlantUML 语法生成安全架构图，包含身份认证、加密、防火墙、合规等图标。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制 IAM 流程、零信任模型、加密管道或威胁检测架构图时触发。

say.text: 画一个用户通过 Cognito 登录访问 S3 的 IAM 流程图。
say.note: 生成 IAM 认证架构图。

say.text: 用防火墙和 WAF 画一个网络安全的架构图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate security architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with icons for identity, encryption, firewall, and compliance based on your description.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to draw IAM flows, zero-trust models, encryption pipelines, or threat detection architectures.

say_en.text: Draw an IAM flow diagram where users log in via Cognito to access S3.
say_en.note: Generates an IAM authentication architecture diagram.

say_en.text: Create a network security diagram with firewall and WAF.
say_en.note: Generates a network security architecture diagram.
